name: Puget Sound links (Chambers Bay)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2, like coastal). A links course on an old gravel mine above Puget Sound: tawny golden native fescue for the rough (no cut rough at Chambers Bay), firm yellow-green fescue fairways, brighter Poa greens, cool grey-white waste sand, grey-blue sound water, dark Douglas firs on the bluff (the pnw tree painters). From the developer's photos in the release chambers-bay-data (2026-10-20). Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
